profile.headline: Software Engineer at Disney
profile.summary: Hi! I'm a Full Stack Developer interested in working on fun and innovative projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Created Restful API’s using Node/Express to deliver digital media assets directly to
customers on demand.
● Created front-end applications for operators to find, create, and deliver audio/video
packages via S3 and Aspera to desired recipients
● Created docker images for EC2 deployment using command line tools, deploying as
needed.
● Implemented and setup Jest unit testing for existing and future applications.
● Created and maintained Postgres, MongoDB and DynamoDB collections to audit all
transactions between business units.
● Used SQS, EC2, Lambda, and AWS Step Functions to orchestrate fully autonomous
work flows.
● Supported legacy software written in meteor.js
● Created tools to generate dynamic manifests for packages that conformed to
movielabs specifications

positions.title: Software Developer●
positions.description:
● Create widgets and endpoints using PHP for large scale data driven SEO pages
● Interfaced with AWS for localized data and images where page load time was critical
● Optimized custom widgets for quick rendering and reusability
● Worked reliably alongside other developers in a remote capacity

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked in conjunction with other developers and designers to completely redesign
high traffic web applications using Angular.js, React and Flight.js
• Implemented analytics (GA) and e-commerce tracking alongside in-house analytic
reporting and updated tagging scheme to be more efficient
• Served as a senior front end developer coordinating with a team of developers across
a number of projects
• Created build environments using Gulp and Webpack to manage and serve assets
under a variety of scenarios
• Used Node.js and React.js to create a custom inventory management software

positions.title: Javascript/Node.js Developer
positions.description:
• Created API endpoints for RESTful services for data driven websites
• Created a password recovery scheme using custom middle wear 
• Wrote test suite for authentication and routing assurance 
• Worked on client facing using MVC architecture (Angular, React – side project) 
• Setup authentication service and access policies using passport.js in a sails environment 
• Created scalable email service for various clients 
• Worked across the stack in order to resolve issues and implement new features

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Worked with other developers and designers in the creation of new sites or additions to existing sites for clients.
• Resolved issues daily using JQuery/PHP/MySQL/HTML/CSS in a fast paced AGILE environment 
• Used to working efficiently in a fast paced environment 
• Created client sites from PSD mockups 
• Participated in the planning and development of new client sites 
• Setup a newsletter subsystem using Amazon SES as well as 
S3 to help deliver content
• Created and maintained a support ticket system 
• Resolved issues relating to system administration in a Unix environment
